statements.status_notes: CVE-2026-102633 is an integer overflow in expat_realloc() when computing allocation sizes on 32-bit platforms, in libexpat 2.7.2 through 2.8.5. Upstream fixed it in Expat 2.9.0 by replacing an assertion, which builds compiled with NDEBUG drop, with a runtime overflow check (libexpat PR #1392, https://github.com/libexpat/libexpat/pull/1392, commit https://github.com/libexpat/libexpat/commit/69edbec09f2cd3e0bd6e0a093b55ea38af902d7d). Alpine 3.23: before moving to 2.9.0, DHI rebuilt Expat 2.8.5 as 2.8.5-r1 with that upstream commit applied. Checked libexpat.so.1 in every published libexpat package for Alpine 3.23, x86_64 and aarch64 (2.7.3-r0 to 2.10.0-r1): every build up to 2.8.5-r0 still contains the assertion text of the old check ("SIZE_MAX - sizeof(size_t) - EXPAT_MALLOC_PADDING >= size"), and 2.8.5-r1, 2.9.0-r1 and 2.10.0-r1 do not; the static library libexpat.a in every published expat-static package for Alpine 3.23 shows the same split at the same versions. So 2.8.5-r1 is the first build carrying the fix.

CVE-2026-102633 is an integer overflow in expat_realloc() when computing allocation sizes on 32-bit platforms, in libexpat 2.7.2 through 2.8.5. Upstream fixed it in Expat 2.9.0 by replacing an assertion, which builds compiled with NDEBUG drop, with a runtime overflow check (libexpat PR #1392, https://github.com/libexpat/libexpat/pull/1392, commit https://github.com/libexpat/libexpat/commit/69edbec09f2cd3e0bd6e0a093b55ea38af902d7d). Debian fixed it for trixie in 2.9.0-1~deb13u1 (DSA-6566-1, https://security-tracker.debian.org/tracker/CVE-2026-102633). Checked libexpat.so.1 in every published libexpat1 package for Debian 13, amd64 and arm64: the 2.8.2-1~deb13u1 and 2.8.3-1~deb13u1 builds still contain the assertion text of the old check ("SIZE_MAX - sizeof(size_t) - EXPAT_MALLOC_PADDING >= size"), and every published 2.9.0-1~deb13u1 build ships upstream Expat 2.9.0 without it; the static library libexpat.a in libexpat1-dev shows the same split at the same versions. The older builds of upstream Expat 2.7.1 predate the code the advisory affects; they sort below the boundary and stay on the affected side of the range. The range's fixed version is the lowest published 2.9.0 build.
